entities.name: Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf was a pre-Islamic Arabic poet and contemporary of Muhammad in Medina, identified by scholars as a Jewish leader.

A key figure in early Islamic history, Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf played a significant role in the development of Arabic literature and poetry.

His poetry, which often dealt with themes of love, war, and social justice, helped shape the literary landscape of the Arabian Peninsula.
